Kua[34651][Text113]: A... new... visitor? Or... new... vessel?\n
Kua[34651][Text211]: Not well... Thank you... for asking...\n
Kua[34651][Text212]: Can you... feel them? Those... wanderers... feeding on... the palace`s power... They carry... pieces... I lack...\n
Kua[34651][Text121]: A complete body... almost restored... Thank you.\n
Kua[34651][Text131]: Threads... joints... wood... Bring them... to me...\n
Kua[34651][Text311]: Empty... handed... Don`t... try to... fool me!\n
Kua[34651][Text321]: You brought my fragments... I can feel them.\n
Kua[34651][Text322]: The number... of fragments... decides... your gain... or... misfortune...\n
Kua[34651][Text331]: Submit %s fragment(s)? Submitting may repair or enrage the puppet.\n
Kua[34651][Text412]: Too few... Not enough... to repair... only... stir my rage!\n
Kua[34651][Text413]: This... scrap... You dare... offer?! Find more... Or... face... my wrath!\n
Kua[34651][Text421]: Hmm... Though small... it is... needed...`\n
Kua[34651][Text422]: Take your... payment... then... bring... more...\n
Kua[34651][Text431]: Two... materials... good... Balance... is... returning...\n
Kua[34651][Text432]: This can... temporarily... stabilize... my... structure...\n
Kua[34651][Text433]: Accept this gift... it is... your due...\n
Kua[34651][Text443]: You have done... what many... lost souls... could not...\n
Kua[34651][Text444]: Choose... your... reward... This is... the respect... you deserve...\n

Npc[34646][Text141]: Recently, frequent child disappearances occur in the city. Witnesses saw children being taken away by a walking puppet. After days of undercover investigation, I suspect this is related to a Puppeteer.\n
Npc[34646][Text211]: A gifted Puppeteer can make puppets walk like real people with just a few strings. A once famous circus had such a Puppeteer. Finding him might yield useful clues.\n
Npc[34646][Text212]: Not long ago, I received an anonymous letter with an address to a dilapidated circus. There, I found a talking doll...\n
Npc[34646][Text213]: The dungeon is linked to the child disappearances; we must go. However, rushing in might alert the enemy. I need your full support in this matter!\n

CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_1_1: Hey, rookie. You better not wander. The walls here can move.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_1_3: I`m Lyon. I track this maze`s secrets. Those missing people... they didn`t get lost, they were `taken`.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_1_4: At midnight, the jester statue at the heart awakens. Want to live? Follow my marks.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_2_1: Ah... failed again. (Lifts a badly damaged face) Will you be my new model? (Suddenly agitated) Just like Lord Puppeteer always did!
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_2_3: Not make... repair! (Tears open collar revealing interior) See these scars? Lord said we were meant to be perfect. (Voice turns cold) Until that day`s betrayal...
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_2_4: The Puppeteer who betrayed the puppets... could it be Mikes?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_3_1: Don`t touch that machine. It`s not `dead` yet.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_3_2: What happened here? Why are these marionettes rampaging?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_3_3: Lord Puppeteer severed the control threads. Now they only hear their own voices. (Whispering) The Dungeon Lord will be furious.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_3_4: Weren`t the Dungeon Lord and the Puppeteer allies?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_3_5: Once. But now? One wants to be a god, the other an executioner.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_4_1: Are you a new audience member? The show started long ago.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_4_3: No one controls me. Lord Puppeteer cut my strings, but I found freedom is more terrifying than obedience.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_4_4: Why did the Puppeteer do this?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_4_5: To prove the Dungeon Lord wrong, to prove we aren`t toys. (Points to darkness above the stage) But see, even the shadows mock him.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_5_1: (Taps a bottle with a fingernail) Buy a memory? The Dungeon Lord`s, the Puppeteer`s, or your own?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_5_3: Truth doesn`t matter, what matters is which one will you believe? (Holds up a crimson vial) Like this one, holds the day the Dungeon Lord took the Puppeteer`s memory.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_5_5: Closer than friends, crueler than enemies.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_6_1: Are you lost? Don`t worry. Everyone finds the exit eventually. (Pause) In the way the Dungeon Lord prefers.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_6_3: For laughter! The Dungeon Lord says, `Those in pain perform joy best`. We had shows daily here, until Lord Puppeteer made the actors take their final bow.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_6_5: He gave us a choice: keep being clowns, or... (Tears open collar revealing gears within) become something else.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_7_1: Have you seen my dance partner? I can`t find him. We danced until our springs ran down... that was last cycle.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_7_3: When moonlight fills the hourglass at the garden`s heart, everything resets. We forget, we dance again, we search again. Unless someone breaks the Puppeteer`s illusion...
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_7_5: He`s the greatest Puppeteer in the world. Be careful! If he finds you, you`ll never escape...
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_8_1: Get lost! Unless you want to be logged as raw material!
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_8_3: It was. Now it`s a slaughterhouse. The Dungeon Lord tosses defective products into the furnace... Lord Puppeteer showed us the truth.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_8_5: Inside every marionette`s core hides a soul that forgot who it was.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_9_1: Such a pity the seats are empty. Would you be today`s special guest?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_9_3: The eternal play The Perfect City! Script by the Dungeon Lord, directed by the Puppeteer... (Voice suddenly distorts) Pity the lead actor walked out.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_9_4: Wasn`t the Puppeteer the Dungeon Lord`s ally?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_9_5: Ally? No, a reflection. (Strings suddenly tighten) He knows better than the Dungeon Lord how to pull heartstrings... Like keeping me awake, watching myself rot.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_10_1: Seventh-gen Marionettes have blue tears. The Dungeon Lord calls it evolution, the Puppeteers call it a malfunction.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_10_2: Why do this factory`s gears never stop turning?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_10_3: Because time`s stuck at midnight. The Dungeon Lord doesn`t want dawn to come.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_10_5: Find the stage`s hidden door, but beware the Puppeteer`s eyes. They remember your shadow.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_11_2: (Fingers twitch, the puppet`s movements grow more complex) Strings... too tight, they snap; too loose, they fall. Like fate, isn`t it?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_11_4: (Slowly turns head for the first time, face seeming to smile, or not) See, it dances for me. And I... (Raises a hand pointing to the endless night sky) For whom do I dance?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_11_5: The show`s over, guest. Next midnight, perhaps you`ll see your own story play out.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_12_1: You have a loose thread. (Plucks a silver strand from your sleeve)
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_12_3: It`s a Puppeteer`s thread. They`ve marked you.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_12_4: But I never touched any puppet!
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_12_5: Not touch, see. Did you stare too long at that Marionette on the Midnight Stage just now?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_12_6: They remember your eyes. Then, slowly weave you into the play.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_12_7: How do I get rid of it?
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_12_8: There`s a lute player nearby with severed fingers. His scores note the Puppeteer`s weakness. But beware, the Dungeon Lord`s `eyes` are near. Go, quickly!
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_13_1: Noctis Bazaar`s wine... One cup for sweet dreams, two for a new body!
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_13_2: (Tears open collar, revealing mechanical joints) Look, so exquisite!
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_13_4: No, I`m human. At least I was yesterday.
CN:FUI_GBJQ_TXT_DESC_25QQWS_ZGZ_13_5: Don`t drink from anyone wearing copper bells. They target drunks, you`ll be a `volunteer` stage puppet by morning!

Plot[9186][MsgBox1]: These Puppet Dolls are being manipulated by some force, and it seems to be just ahead!
Plot[9186][MsgBox2]: The garden floor suddenly twists; an ancient puppet curse has been activated!
Plot[9186][MsgBox3]: Time in this garden seems shattered into pieces. A strange light flickers in the distance, almost calling to you...
Plot[9187][MsgBox1]: Is that a figure moving inside the Crack? Could the missing children be here?
Plot[9188][MsgBox1]: Mikes is indeed involved in the disappearances. Papet must be hiding something.
Plot[9188][Text2]: I didn`t think you`d find out so soon. Tielle didn`t mean to hide it. That bad man threatened Tielle, said if Tielle told anyone, `Papa` would be turned into a Marionette.\n
Plot[9188][Text3]: Old Zack uses puppets to steal children from the city, turning them into Marionettes to perform for guests in the dungeon. But crafting Marionettes requires a highly gifted Puppeteer, so Old Zack tricked Mikes.\n
Plot[9188][Text4]: Please awaken the Marionettes quickly! Otherwise, if they lose their last shred of will, the children will be lost forever! Awakened Marionettes will enter the Puppet Home and become your most capable assistants in the dungeon!\n
Plot[9188][Text6]: Another fool seeking death! Don`t rush. After I devour your soul, I`ll remember your sacrifice!\n
Plot[9188][Text7]: The Puppeteer... It`s all because of the Puppeteer... I`ll never forgive you!\n
Plot[9189][MsgBox1]: Why are all the spectators here staring so intently at the dancer on stage?
Plot[9190][MsgBox1]: Head to the center of the stage and see what Nixie is really up to.
Plot[9190][MsgBox2]: You try to approach the stage, but the surroundings begin to warp and blur.
Plot[9190][MsgBox3]: The path beneath your feet seems endless; you`ve returned to the starting point once more.
Plot[9191][MsgBox1]: The scene shatters like broken glass, and you are instantly teleported to the center of the stage.
Plot[9191][MsgBox2]: Space distorts again, a powerful force pushing you away. Papet seems to have found something. Go discuss with it!
Plot[9191][Text1]: I sense powerful illusion magic! The paths we see are all false reflections! Like the moon in water, the more you push forward, the farther you are from the truth.\n
Plot[9191][Text2]: Try going against your intuition, walk in the opposite direction of your goal. Perhaps you can find the weak point in this `mirage`!\n
Plot[9191][Text4]: You actually saw through and broke my illusion?! Unforgivable!\n
Plot[9191][Text5]: Fool who disrupted this eternal feast, use your soul to make up for it!\n
Plot[9191][MsgBox3]: Nixie`s performance isn`t over yet. Please dispel the illusion first!
Plot[9191][MsgBox4]: Nixie`s performance isn`t over yet. Please regroup with Papet first!
Plot[9192][MsgBox1]: The Noctis Bazaar is the dungeon`s info hub. You can buy any news for the right price. Mikes` trail might be found here.
Plot[9192][Text3]: Take a look, traveler! Finest glowstones! Fresh from the Underground Cave. They say only Marionettes can enter. Besides the Archon, I`m the only one in the dungeon who has them!\n
Plot[9192][Text5]: What Mikes? I`ve never heard of him. Scram! I`m not doing business with you.\n
Plot[9192][MsgBox2]: The person appeared in a sudden. Could she have news about Mikes?
Plot[9192][Text7]: Looking for Mikes? I heard Old Zack has him hidden! The bond between master and apprentice couldn`t withstand greed.\n
Plot[9192][Text8]: The dungeon is about to welcome the world`s greatest Puppeteer. Guess who that might be... Shh, I can`t say more. We`re being watched...\n
Plot[9192][MsgBox3]: A Coachman has appeared beside you unnoticed... His gaze fixed intently on you...
Plot[9192][Text10]: Old Zack? He`s nothing but a doorman! The dungeon`s power is stirring. Someone seeks to control it. The real secret is known only to the puppet who holds the scepter.\n
Plot[9192][MsgBox5]: These people are actually manipulated marionettes! Defeat them quickly!
Plot[9192][MsgBox6]: Would the Florist have news about Mikes?
Plot[9193][MsgBox1]: The mastermind behind the Noctis Bazaar is actually a puppet! She must hold even greater secrets!
Plot[9193][Text3]: Poor lost lamb, thinking you`ve uncovered some great secret? Everything you `heard` was just bait I deliberately laid out.\n
Plot[9193][Option1]: All this was to lure us in?
Plot[9193][Text4]: Don`t flatter yourself. I just wanted to see what interesting fools I could catch. You have no idea what the dungeon truly means.\n
Plot[9193][Text5]: Or else what? With your pitiful strength, you think you can oppose me? Oppose the true master of this dungeon?\n
Plot[9193][Text6]: Laughable! Let me show you firsthand the gap of despair!\n
Plot[9194][MsgBox1]: The puppet Tielle`s power is unfathomable, yet she let you live. This isn`t mercy, but a transaction yet to be priced.
Plot[9194][Text1]: See? As easy as crushing a bug.\n
Plot[9194][Text2]: However, your little pet puppet is somewhat interesting. Though you are pathetically weak now, it seems to have potential. Work with me. Only I can help you.\n
Plot[9194][Text3]: I am Tielle, once loyal to the Puppeteer, Lord Mikes. But now, I am just an empty shell who has lost her way, because Lord Mikes` memories were brutally taken and sealed away by that thief, Old Zack.\n
Plot[9194][Text4]: Without those memories, Lord Mikes cannot even recognize himself, let alone be free. The only way to truly save Lord Mikes is to defeat Old Zack and force him to return everything he stole!\n
Plot[9194][Text5]: I am a puppet. The laws of creation are engraved in our cores: we cannot defy our creator. Even if Old Zack is a despicable thief, he currently holds the authority of the `Puppeteer`.\n
Plot[9194][Text6]: I cannot raise a hand against him, not even in thought...\n
Plot[9194][Option3]: But I couldn`t even hurt you.
Plot[9194][Text7]: This is the most powerful weapon I can wield: [url=][color=#52C769]Violet Dreamkey[/color][/url]. Now, I entrust it to you.\n
Plot[9194][Text8]: A great conspiracy is brewing in the dungeon`s dark side. Old Zack is its guardian. Take my power and my will, defeat him, venture into the dark dungeon, and crush that personage`s ambition!\n
Plot[9194][Text9]: This is not just for Lord Mikes, but for all enslaved souls...\n
Plot[9194][Text11]: You dare challenge the dungeon`s greatest puppeteer? Good, I admire your courage.\n
Plot[9194][Text12]: I`ll take your body as my new vessel!\n
Plot[9194][Text13]: A mere ant dares speak to me!\n
Plot[9195][MsgBox1]: This is the dark side garden of the dungeon, even more sinister and terrifying than before.
Plot[9195][Text2]: Prune... must prune... maintain beauty... for the garden...\n
Plot[9195][Text3]: This isn`t ordinary hypnosis or string manipulation... Their souls have been drained, leaving only empty shells. We can`t see the strings because they are carved into their bones.\n
Plot[9195][Option5]: Is there a way to fix this?
Plot[9195][Text4]: This garden is the core sustaining the soul control. Only by completely destroying it can the control be severed.\n
Plot[9195][Text5]: The Archon must have hidden explosives underground here. I`ll try to lure the people in the garden away. The rest is up to you.\n
Plot[9195][Text7]: This garden is very eerie. Observe the surroundings first!\n
Plot[9196][MsgBox1]: You found the explosives the Archon buried here. Now go ignite them!
Plot[9197][MsgBox1]: So a Marionette was controlling the Gardener after all!
Plot[9197][Text2]: No! My perfect soul container! What have you done?! You ignorant human, how dare you destroy my steps towards perfection!\n
Plot[9197][Text3]: What? I was once one of my master`s finest creations! But he... he discarded me for a minor imperfection!\n
Plot[9197][Text4]: He said I had no heart, no true soul, that I was just a cold tool!\n
Plot[9197][Text5]: So what! I will create my own, most perfect soul! Then I will truly live!\n
Plot[9197][Text6]: This garden, these nutrients, were the foundation of my great plan! And you... you ruined it!\n
Plot[9197][Text7]: In that case, use your soul to repay me!\n
Plot[9198][MsgBox1]: The Archon just left this place. Maybe others know where he went.
Plot[9198][Text2]: Archon? Ah... that noble personage... He greatly appreciates our art. He said our struggles and spins are the most beautiful.\n
Plot[9198][Text3]: He made me shoes that never stop spinning. He will bring them to me soon...\n
Plot[9198][MsgBox2]: You feel a slight dizziness, your arms inexplicably heavier.
Plot[9198][Text5]: The master likes our music. He says it`s the soul`s wails and moans, the noblest movement.\n
Plot[9198][MsgBox3]: The dizziness intensifies! Your arms feel even heavier, as if weighed down by lead.
Plot[9198][Text6]: The Dancer is the Archon`s favorite...\n
Plot[9198][Text8]: I`m just a Waiter, I don`t even get to see the Archon.\n
Plot[9198][Text9]: Information? The master is everywhere. Can`t you see? The beautiful threads that bind everything...\n
Plot[9199][MsgBox1]: You`ve been bound by Manipulator Strings! Quickly tear the surrounding threads!
Plot[9199][Text2]: By my master`s command, none shall leave here today!!\n
Plot[9199][Text3]: Master said no one may leave...\n
Plot[9200][MsgBox1]: You finally found Mikes, but he seems to remember nothing!
Plot[9200][Text2]: You`ve finally come... Any later... and it would be too late...\n
Plot[9200][Text3]: Listen, that madman, the Archon, his plan is far more terrifying than anyone imagines!\n
Plot[9200][Text4]: His goal isn`t rule or power. He seeks a twisted form of `eternity`!\n
Plot[9200][Text5]: He wants to turn everyone in the dungeon, residents, adventurers, even the monsters, into Marionettes!\n
Plot[9200][Text6]: Yes! Forcibly imprison living souls into meticulously crafted puppet bodies! He believes this is the only way to escape the fragility of flesh and the brevity of life, to achieve his so-called `perfect eternity`!\n
Plot[9200][Text9]: Remember the [url=][color=#52C769]Violet Dreamkey[/color][/url] Tielle gave you? It`s the key to the Marionette Factory. Place it at the Barrier Weft to enter!\n
Plot[9200][Text10]: For all who still live, and for the souls about to be eternally imprisoned! Please!\n
Plot[9200][MsgBox2]: Mikes` eyes suddenly roll back, his body contorts and transforms into a Corrupted Puppet!
Plot[9200][MsgBox3]: Mikes has regained some sanity. Go talk to him!
Plot[9201][MsgBox1]: More puppets are appearing! Defeat them quickly!
Plot[9201][MsgBox2]: Watch out! Five exquisite puppets emerge from the ground, advancing towards you!
Plot[9201][MsgBox3]: The Marionette Factory is open! The Archon`s puppets attack!
Plot[9201][Text2]: You passed all my trials and defeated all my masterpieces.\n
Plot[9201][Text3]: This perfectly proves your strength. Your soul is the ultimate vessel I seek.\n
Plot[9201][Text4]: Join me! Cast aside that fragile flesh, let me transfer your soul into this eternal marionette!\n
Plot[9201][Text5]: Together we`ll transcend mortality! You`ll gain supreme power and true immortality!\n
Plot[9201][Text6]: Fool!! Shortsighted!! You... you refuse this gift?\n
Plot[9201][Text7]: Then I must tear you apart, piece by piece!\n
Plot[9201][Text8]: I`ll personally extract your soul, imprison it in my finest creation, forcing you to witness my eternal glory!\n
Plot[9201][Text9]: Child, you haven`t truly witnessed my puppetry arts!\n
Plot[9201][Text10]: My Marionette Factory welcomes no uninvited guests, especially not you.\n
